themes.name: Covenants as living, protective, generational power
themes.claim: Covenants are presented as active power that binds the keeper to Christ, reaches across generations, and cannot be voided by another person's choices.

themes.name: Adversity reframed: purposeful, not prevented
themes.claim: Speakers corrected a prosperity reading of obedience: faithfulness does not prevent trial, trial is purposeful, and deliverance comes in God's time and way.

themes.name: Christ as the active agent: grace that lifts and carries
themes.claim: Christ, not the self, is cast as the agent of change (carrying, lifting, sculpting), and receiving that help requires setting aside pride and self-reliance.

themes.name: Discipleship as striving, not prior perfection
themes.claim: Discipleship is framed as sustained trying rather than a perfection threshold, which lowers the felt cost of failing.
themes.anchor: Dube: 'We do not need to perfect ourselves to come to Christ' (T23.06)

themes.name: Seeing and ministering to the one
themes.claim: God's promise to succor is described as fulfilled mainly through ordinary people who first notice the individual, so ministry starts with seeing.
themes.anchor: Kimball via H. Eyring and Chibota: 'usually through another person' (T19.12, T20.09)

themes.name: Divine identity and unearned love over labels
themes.claim: Identity as a child of God, and a love that cannot be earned or lost, is offered as the antidote to worldly labels, paired with a warning that love is not license.

themes.name: Truth with love: peacemaking, unity, and boundaries
themes.claim: Sunday's speakers converged on a two-part ethic: forgo contention and seek unity, while not trading truth for approval.
themes.anchor: Gilbert: 'truth and love always walk together' (T36.26)

themes.name: Small consistent practices and guarded attention
themes.claim: Small, consistent practices are framed as protective, and their neglect, often through digital distraction, as the mechanism of gradual drift.

themes.name: A giving economy: sacrificial laws vs something for nothing
themes.claim: Saturday set sacrificial giving laws (fasting, offerings, tithing) against gambling's take-without-giving logic, recasting money as a test of trust and neighbor-love.

themes.name: Witness and invitation
themes.claim: Testimony is democratized: every member is cast as a witness whose simple words carry power, anchored to apostolic witness and an invitation extended to all people.
themes.anchor: Causse: 'It only needs to be true' (T03.17)
